company.description: Company or client the project was made for (null to clear)

startYear.description: Year the work started (null to clear)

endYear.description: Year the work ended (null to clear)

ongoing.description: The project is still running. true requires a start year and no end year, evaluated on the resulting state: setting an endYear on a running project needs ongoing: false in the same request (400 otherwise). Omitted keeps the stored value

showOnHomepage.description: Whether to show this project on the homepage

version.description: The `version` of the record the change is based on (from its detail). When another one is stored, nothing is written and the answer is 409 with the code VERSION_CONFLICT. Left out, the change is written without the check
